units.source_text: 荣吉去买船票和舢板票的工夫，我找了许多话题同她攀谈，她却一味低头望着运河入海处，一声不响。

en.t: While Eikichi was buying the boat and skiff tickets, I tried to talk with her about all sorts of things, but she only kept her head lowered and gazed toward the place where the canal flowed into the sea, saying nothing at all.

units.source_text: 每次我还没把话讲完，她就一个劲儿点头。

en.t: Each time, before I had even finished speaking, she simply kept nodding.
